article.title: AGIBOT Debuts A3 Humanoid Robot in Europe, Launches UK Robot-as-a-Service Rental Model
article.summary: AGIBOT unveiled its A3 humanoid in Europe and launched UK robot rental pricing starting at £1,999 a day, days after marking its 15,000th robot produced.
article.body_markdown:
## Overview

AGIBOT, the Shanghai-based humanoid robot developer, showed the European debut of its A3 humanoid robot and launched a UK Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) rental model at the UK AGIBOT Partner Conference (APC) 2026 in London, according to [Robotics and Automation News](https://roboticsandautomationnews.com/2026/07/02/agibot-debuts-a3-humanoid-robot-in-europe-and-launches-uk-robot-as-a-service-model/103018/). The event came days after AGIBOT said its 15,000th robot had completed production, according to [The Robot Report](https://www.therobotreport.com/agibot-produces-15000th-robot-marking-milestone-embodied-ai-deployment/).

## What We Know

The AGIBOT A3 that debuted in London has a lightweight 55-kilogram body reinforced with magnesium and titanium alloy, a dual-battery system rated for up to 10 hours of nominal battery life, and a battery-swap process that takes 10 seconds, according to [Robotics and Automation News](https://roboticsandautomationnews.com/2026/07/02/agibot-debuts-a3-humanoid-robot-in-europe-and-launches-uk-robot-as-a-service-model/103018/). Standing 173 centimeters tall with a 1:9 head-to-body ratio, the robot is designed to combine stronger motion performance, longer operating time and a more natural appearance, according to [Robotics and Automation News](https://roboticsandautomationnews.com/2026/07/02/agibot-debuts-a3-humanoid-robot-in-europe-and-launches-uk-robot-as-a-service-model/103018/).

Under the new UK RaaS program, AGIBOT humanoid robots will be available to rent starting at £1,999 per day, while quadruped robots start at £899 per day, with localized deployment and operational support included, according to [Robotics and Automation News](https://roboticsandautomationnews.com/2026/07/02/agibot-debuts-a3-humanoid-robot-in-europe-and-launches-uk-robot-as-a-service-model/103018/).

"The UK is a strategically important market for AGIBOT's global expansion," said William Shi, president of EU and US Markets at AGIBOT. "It has a strong innovation ecosystem, a mature partner network, and diverse real-world scenarios where embodied AI can create value," according to [Robotics and Automation News](https://roboticsandautomationnews.com/2026/07/02/agibot-debuts-a3-humanoid-robot-in-europe-and-launches-uk-robot-as-a-service-model/103018/).

The London event followed AGIBOT's announcement that its 15,000th robot — an AGIBOT G2 wheeled mobile manipulator with a humanoid torso and arms built for industrial applications — had completed production, according to [The Robot Report](https://www.therobotreport.com/agibot-produces-15000th-robot-marking-milestone-embodied-ai-deployment/). Dr. Yao Maoqing, partner and senior vice president at AGIBOT, called the rollout "not only an important milestone in AGIBOT's mass production and engineering delivery capabilities, but also a reflection of the broader industry's move toward scaled deployment in real-world settings," according to [The Robot Report](https://www.therobotreport.com/agibot-produces-15000th-robot-marking-milestone-embodied-ai-deployment/).

AGIBOT, founded in 2023 and based in Shanghai, said expanding production from 1,000 to 5,000 units took approximately one year, while the jump from 5,000 to 10,000 units took only three months — more than a fourfold acceleration, according to [The Robot Report](https://www.therobotreport.com/agibot-produces-15000th-robot-marking-milestone-embodied-ai-deployment/). In late June, the company logged approximately 100 cumulative hours of factory livestream operations in which a G2 robot performed quality inspections of tablets alongside human line workers, according to [The Robot Report](https://www.therobotreport.com/agibot-produces-15000th-robot-marking-milestone-embodied-ai-deployment/). Market research firm Omdia ranked AGIBOT first globally in humanoid robot shipments during 2025, crediting the company with 5,168 annual shipments and a 39 percent share of the global market, according to [The Robot Report](https://www.therobotreport.com/agibot-produces-15000th-robot-marking-milestone-embodied-ai-deployment/).

The UK RaaS pricing builds on a broader rental push AGIBOT began in March, when it unveiled a global online storefront and rental platform at MWC 2026 in Barcelona, offering rentals starting at €899 a day across 17 countries and regions, including the UK, Spain, Germany, France, Italy and North America, according to [Humanoids Daily](https://www.humanoidsdaily.com/news/agibot-launches-global-rental-platform-at-mwc-2026-offering-humanoids-for-899-a-day). At the time, Shi — then described as AGIBOT's president of Europe — said, "We see Europe as a vital hub for innovation," and that the company aims to "co-develop a robust embodied AI ecosystem" through open collaboration, according to [Humanoids Daily](https://www.humanoidsdaily.com/news/agibot-launches-global-rental-platform-at-mwc-2026-offering-humanoids-for-899-a-day).

## What We Don't Know

AGIBOT has not disclosed how many UK customers have signed on to the new RaaS program, how many A3 units are earmarked for the UK market, or a specific date on which rentals begin reaching customers. Robotics and Automation News did not report an exact date for the APC2026 event beyond confirming it took place in London. Neither AGIBOT nor the outlets covering the launch explain how the new UK-specific pricing of £1,999 and £899 per day relates to the €899-per-day starting price AGIBOT quoted for its broader European rental platform in March, or how many of the 15,000 robots produced to date have shipped to the UK specifically.

## Analysis

AGIBOT's UK push follows a two-step pattern: broaden service availability globally first, then localize pricing and support market by market. The March MWC platform already listed the UK among 17 countries covered by its rental service, according to [Humanoids Daily](https://www.humanoidsdaily.com/news/agibot-launches-global-rental-platform-at-mwc-2026-offering-humanoids-for-899-a-day); the July APC2026 event converts that listing into UK-specific terms, a named local rollout, and the A3's European debut, according to [Robotics and Automation News](https://roboticsandautomationnews.com/2026/07/02/agibot-debuts-a3-humanoid-robot-in-europe-and-launches-uk-robot-as-a-service-model/103018/). The timing also follows closely on AGIBOT's 15,000th-robot milestone and the fourfold acceleration in its production ramp, according to [The Robot Report](https://www.therobotreport.com/agibot-produces-15000th-robot-marking-milestone-embodied-ai-deployment/) — a manufacturing base the company will need to support both direct sales and the rental fleet it is now offering in London.
